title: Europixel
description: A Minecraft server network with Duels and more.
body:
# ⚔️ EuroPixel Network

The ultimate Minecraft PvP Network based in Europe. High performance, zero lag, and competitive gameplay.

### 🚀 Features
* **Competitive Duels:** Different kits, fair fights, and perfect hit registration.
* **Global Leaderboards:** Track your stats and climb to the top.
* **Active Community:** Join daily events and meet other players.
* **Lag-Free:** Optimized server hardware for the best PvP experience.

### 🔗 Links
* 📺 [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@europixel-network)
* 💬 [Discord](https://discord.europixel.eu/)

**IP:** `play.europixel.eu`
